summary: Current IS-IS flooding rates are much slower than modern networks can support, and larger deployments need faster flooding to meet convergence goals. This experimental document discusses the need and the issues, describes example approaches, and defines related protocol extensions.

eli5.summary: Routers pass news to each other, but they do it slowly, like passing notes one at a time. This experiment speeds up passing the notes without overwhelming anyone.

questions: how to speed up is-is lsp flooding
